svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 mm PETG sheet. Blank 328 x 228; fold up 14 mm on all four sides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (heat gun and a wooden former), so the tray is 300 x 200 x 14.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal each corner inside with a fillet of clear silicone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drain hole 12 in the outdoor end wall, 40 left of centre, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre 6 up from the underside so the bore is flush with the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four pads 20 x 20 x 12 cut from PETG offcuts stacked and glued, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the four corners, 10 in from each end and 60 out from the centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line; the core sits on them, so water runs freely underneath.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on the floor lining between the core frames.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: fill with 100 ml of water with the drain tube fitted; it all

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: runs out with the box level, and no corner weeps.
